name: @repo/auth
//exports: No patch kind edits an exports map, so entries a feature module fills are declared here up front. './access' is filled by teams (src/access.ts, the permission vocabulary), './tenant' by multitenant (src/tenant.ts, requireTenant and the resolver table), './rbac' by rbac (src/rbac.ts, requireCan) and './rbac-rules' by rbac as well (src/rbac-rules.ts, the import-free can()). './rbac' pulls hono and the auth instance, so only './access' and './rbac-rules' are safe in a browser bundle; apps/admin imports can() from the latter to hide a control. Until each module is installed its subpath resolves to nothing and nothing imports it.
